latestVersion.changelog:
Maker Editor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a full-featured AI video editor for content creators and marketers.
- Upload raw MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and specify editing instructions in plain language.
- Automatic handling of pauses, background music, aspect ratio, overlays, and exports in 1080p MP4.
- Built-in anonymous authentication with session management and free token system.
- Provides clear user status updates, error handling, and easy download of finished videos.
- Supports fast turnaround (30–90 seconds for short clips) and multiple common editing workflows.
